title: N11 fixed native groups and conditional policies
coordinate_convention: Native gated MLP channel before down projection; flat=layer*6144+channel for these layers. Gate/up rows and down columns share a channel.
individual_panel: First8units of each group,4frozen sentinels per condition. Group order is part of recipe. Raw tasks and donor values remain private.
donor_contract: Caller supplies actual unmodified recipient,samepolicy,opposite donor states plus corrupted background_self states at the same absolute selector position. No fitted vectors or hardcoded task answers. Public native_group_policy consumes these named states.

application.arguments: model,position,condition,donors,coordinates;default block5..9. Slice group to condition.size;single-unit uses condition.rank.
